desc:
CAKE MIX: There’s pudding in the mix to give the cake a rich, decadent flavor and texture; Bake a triple chocolate fudge cake dessert for gatherings, parties, or entertaining family

QUICK AND EASY: Make a cake by just adding a few simple ingredients as directed and popping in the oven

ENDLESS OPTIONS: Add your own twist to these mixes by trying Betty Crocker recipes; Turn this cake mix into a festive family activity by adding Betty Crocker Frosting or a cake decorating kit

DELICIOUS & MOIST: Use this versatile cake mix to whip up delicious, moist cake

CONTAINS: One 13.25 oz box of Betty Crocker Delights Super Moist Triple Chocolate Fudge Cake Mix
features:
Features

Rich Chocolate Fudge Flavor

Made with cocoa processed with alkali for a deep, smooth, and indulgent chocolate taste.

Super Moist Texture

Delivers a soft, fluffy, and tender cake that stays moist after baking.

Quick and Easy Preparation

Just add water, oil, and eggs—no complicated steps, perfect for all skill levels.

Versatile Baking Options

Ideal for sheet cakes, layer cakes, cupcakes, Bundt cakes, and more.

Customizable Base

Works beautifully with various frostings, mix-ins like chocolate chips or nuts, or flavor twists.

Generous Serving Size

One box yields a full 13x9 cake or up to 24 cupcakes.

Kosher Certified and Box Tops for Education Eligible

Suitable for specific dietary preferences and helps support schools.

Trusted Brand

From a brand with a long-standing reputation for reliable, delicious baking products.

Benefits

Effortless Homemade Taste

Delivers bakery-style results with minimal effort—ideal for busy families or new bakers.

Perfect for Celebrations and Everyday Cravings

Suitable for birthdays, holidays, potlucks, or weeknight desserts.

Dependable Results Every Time

Consistent texture, moisture, and flavor in every batch—no baking surprises.

Crowd-Pleasing Chocolate Flavor

Loved by kids and adults alike for its rich, chocolatey taste.

Great Value

Affordable way to create delicious desserts that look and taste homemade.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Cocoa Processed with Alkali (red Dutched and dark Dutched), Corn Syrup, Chocolate Chips (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural flavor), Leavening (baking soda, monocalcium phosphate, sodium aluminum phosphate). Contains 2% or less of: Modified Corn Starch, Corn Starch, Propylene Glycol Mono and Diesters, Monoglycerides, Palm Oil, Salt, Dicalcium Phosphate, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Xanthan Gum, Cellulose Gum, Carob Powder, Artificial Flavor.
